sections.body: Music can be loud or quiet. How loud music is, is called its DYNAMICS. 🔊🔈
Music can be fast or slow. How fast music is, is called its TEMPO. 🐇🐢
A lullaby is usually quiet and slow. A party song is often loud and fast!
Musicians change dynamics and tempo to show feelings: calm, happy, scary or exciting.
Clap a beat. Make it slow like a turtle, then fast like a rabbit. Now clap very quietly!
Free tools like Chrome Music Lab let children play with tempo. Ask how different music makes them feel.

quiz.q: How fast music is played is called its…
hints: One word is about speed, one about loudness.
Musicians write words like 'allegro' (fast) or 'adagio' (slow) at the top of music. Those words set this.
Dynamics means loud or quiet. Which word is left for fast or slow?
quiz.explain: Tempo is how fast or slow music is.

quiz.q: A lullaby to help a baby sleep is usually…
hints: What helps a baby feel calm?
Would shouting help a baby sleep?
A party song is loud and fast, to make you dance. A sleepy song is the opposite.
quiz.explain: Lullabies are quiet and slow to help babies relax.

quiz.q: How loud or quiet music is, is called…
hints: Speed is tempo. So the word for loudness is the other one.
quiz.explain: Dynamics is how loud or quiet music is.
